title: James-Specific Memory Write Binding and Carrier Reuse Audit

gate.name: JAMES_SPECIFIC_MEMORY_WRITE_BINDING_AND_CARRIER_REUSE_AUDIT
gate.question: Does shipped Fallout 3 expose an asset-level chain from the individual Vault 112 subject James to a removable memory carrier, including a concrete READ/COPY/WRITE or export operation sufficient to promote SAVE JAMES beyond conditional reconstruction?
gate.passed_boundary: A James-specific physical session/pod source selector is established at the asset level, and per-user memory access is explicitly a Vault 112 capability.
gate.failed_or_open_boundary: No shipped asset reviewed exposes a James-specific memory-to-carrier binding, a manipulable memory-chip object record, or a concrete COPY/WRITE/EXPORT command from selected Vault 112 user memory to a carrier.

james_specific_source_binding.interpretation: The source side no longer needs to be represented as an anonymous generic Vault 112 user. Shipped assets distinguish James through a Dad-specific lounger terminal, Dad-specific physiological records and a distinct Doc simulation representation.

version_control_note.relevant_statement: Updated neural inputs to override memory access for individual users

version_control_terminal.interpretation: The shipped terminal surface exposes documentation/read operations. The note proves per-user memory access exists in the system architecture, but the terminal does not expose an operator command that copies selected memory to removable media.

observations: James's physical monitor reports an UNKNOWN/unverified resident identity.
MQ04VersionControlCurrent contains static entries 'User UNKNOWN Granted Access' and 'User UNKNOWN Altered by S. Braun'.
unknown_user_binding_audit.candidate: The UNKNOWN version-control entry may refer to James or another unregistered entrant.
unknown_user_binding_audit.reason: The shipped text does not uniquely bind the singular UNKNOWN entry to James, and the Lone Wanderer is also an unregistered entrant into the system.

dad_pod.finding: The Dad pod has its own activation script, but it only blocks/conditions activation and exposes no memory read, copy, write or export operation.

player_container_exit.finding: The exit script restores the player's physical state, opens the player's and Dad's pod shells, turns PlayerInTL off, clears James ghost/unconscious state and causes James to reevaluate his package. No James-memory export or carrier-write call is present in the reviewed script.

quest_script.finding: The reviewed MQ04 quest script tracks simulation state, resets and quest transitions. No concrete memory-chip copy/write/export path for James was identified.

narrative_physical_carrier.finding: Pinkerton states that he stole a mem chip from Braun and that the carrier contains memories whose source identity he does not know before integration.

ms08_record_named_mem_chip.finding: The exposed Form ID named 'Mem chip' is Pinkerton's log text, not demonstrated to be the physical memory chip object he stole.

circuit_neuralizer.finding: Pinkerton says he built a Circuit Neuralizer from spare parts and uses the memory procedure, but the device is not exposed by the reviewed shipped evidence as a manipulable world item with a carrier-write API.

host_integration.finding: The destination side remains strong: Pinkerton obtains a memory payload and gets those memories into A3-21, producing the Harkness autobiographical layer.

rewritability_audit.community_claim: Older secondary documentation describes Vault 112 memory chips as resident-specific and rewritable and identifies T. Dithers as the stolen source.
rewritability_audit.reason: The cited shipped logs establish a stolen memory carrier and later host integration but do not themselves bind the carrier to Dithers, prove a per-resident removable-chip architecture, or demonstrate a carrier rewrite command.

strongest_admitted_chain.access: per-user memory access is an explicit Vault 112 architectural capability
strongest_admitted_chain.carrier_class: portable mem chip exists in shipped Pinkerton narrative
strongest_admitted_chain.destination: Pinkerton can integrate memory payload into A3-21
strongest_admitted_chain.compressed: JAMES_SOURCE_BINDING -> PASS; MEMORY_ACCESS_CAPABILITY -> PASS; CARRIER_CLASS -> PASS; HOST_IMPORT -> PASS; SOURCE_TO_CARRIER_WRITE_EDGE -> OPEN

save_james_effect.improvement: The capture source can now be anchored to James's specific Vault 112 pod/session assets instead of an abstract generic per-user selector.
save_james_effect.reason_for_no_full_promotion: The one required technical edge from selected James memory state to a removable carrier remains absent from the reviewed shipped asset-level evidence.

ru: У James есть собственная asset-level точка выбора источника: Vault112PodTermDad и отдельные Dad status/stress records связывают физический lounger с его конкретной сессией.

Vault 112 прямо документирует возможность переопределять memory access для отдельных пользователей, но shipped Version Control terminal предоставляет только чтение заметок и не раскрывает COPY/WRITE/EXPORT команду.
Form ID 00024D63 с названием 'Mem chip' является NOTE/holotape-записью Пинкертона о краже чипа, а не доказанным Form ID самого физического memory carrier.

Pinkerton подтверждает существование переносимого memory carrier и успешный импорт памяти в A3-21, поэтому обе стороны моста существуют; не найдено только shipped-ребро между выбранной памятью James и записью на carrier.
SAVE JAMES повышается по точности источника до POD-BOUND CONDITIONAL PROTOCOL, но не до vanilla executable или canonical backup path.
en: James now has an asset-level source selector: Vault112PodTermDad and Dad-specific status/stress records bind a physical lounger to his session.
Vault 112 explicitly documents per-user memory-access override capability, but the shipped Version Control terminal exposes only note-reading and no COPY/WRITE/EXPORT command.
Form ID 00024D63 named 'Mem chip' is Pinkerton's NOTE/holotape record about the theft, not an established Form ID for the physical carrier itself.
Pinkerton confirms both a portable memory carrier and successful memory import into A3-21; the unresolved edge is the shipped write from selected James memory to that carrier.
SAVE JAMES is strengthened to a POD-BOUND CONDITIONAL PROTOCOL, not promoted to a vanilla executable or canonical backup path.

next_gate.name: VAULT112_HIDDEN_OR_CUT_MEMORY_CARRIER_OBJECT_AND_EXPORT_SCRIPT_AUDIT
targets: Search all Fallout3.esm record classes, not only NOTE/TERM/SCPT, for unused or cut Editor IDs containing memory chip, memchip, Visiontron memory, neuralizer, engram, memory transfer, copy, export or write.
Search placed references and ownership/reference chains around each Vault 112 lounger for hidden attached objects or enable-parented carrier references.

Search scripts and terminal embedded scripts for indirect operations through generic containers, RemoveAllItems/AddItem, SetLinkedRef-like patterns or quest-stage side effects that could represent carrier movement.
Search cut/unused content separately and label any result CUT_CONTENT rather than shipped canonical gameplay.
If a James/resident-specific carrier binding plus write/export operation is found, authorize SAVE JAMES protocol promotion to ASSET_LEVEL_EXECUTABLE_RECONSTRUCTION.
